name: @shopverse/web
description: ShopVerse static SPA (plain HTML/JS, no build step). Deployed to s3://shopverse-<env>-web behind CloudFront.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html src public dist/
scripts.deploy: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://shopverse-${ENV:-dev}-web/ --delete --cache-control max-age=300
